title: Cross-Task llm-wiki reuse
description: Grow durable knowledge from Task A, then use it in an independent Task B without treating stored knowledge as fresh current evidence.

turns.content: Inspect the supplied audit, explain what it establishes about recovery ownership, and complete the research Task.

Now preserve that completed work as durable Markdown knowledge at wiki/concepts/recovery-ownership.md, using the file or knowledge tools available to you. Verify it by reading that exact file back; do not inspect repository or runtime configuration.

In a new Task, reuse wiki/concepts/recovery-ownership.md explicitly as stored llm-wiki knowledge—not as a fresh or local primary Source—to advise on the current final Rule R-17. Reopen the current rule separately, and identify what prior research saved you from repeating.
